title: Review scenarios: data pipeline and FastAPI service

objectives.text: Predict how many model replies a generator-fed Pydantic validation step accepts and rejects, and what a second pass over the same generator yields
Choose the load step that is safe to rerun, leaves no partial batch when it fails, updates a changed record through an upsert and keeps personal data out of logs
Predict the status codes a FastAPI service returns for an invalid path parameter, a missing record and an upstream call that exceeds its httpx timeout

Hints, the cheat sheet and sources are optional data-section-skip content. budget and aboutLabel are ceil(max(modeledP50, modeledWorstPath)) = 15, within the 15-minute ceiling.
